message: Good morning, Jane! How's your day going? I was telling my friend about your job, and she was so impressed. What kind of clients are you working with today?

Morning, Mom! Just got to the office. It's going to be a busy day with back-to-back meetings. I have a lunch meeting with Michael Brown to discuss his W2 and earnings report. He's had a significant increase in his wages this year due to his promotion, so we'll be adjusting his financial plan accordingly. I'll tell you all about it later!
Jane, did you remember to send your aunt the birthday card? She's been looking forward to it!
Yes, I sent it last week. She should get it any day now. Thanks for the reminder, Mom!
